data.content:
Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [Terrible Service](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/664c170abbf5b151152052d1)

Things look great on their website. But service plainly sucks.

I am so frustrated with Lulu and Georgia’s service. This is the second bed I am ordering and again there are major issues. With the first bed there were piece missing that did not allow me to assemble it. This time around I got only the headboard! There is no frame, no slats, nothing! My house is in complete disarray because I can’t put a bedroom together until the bed comes, my daughter has no bed to sleep in…. So infuriating. It is not like their merch is discounted so I can make an argument that you get what you pay for. They charge you a pretty penny but don’t delver. To top it off there is no number for customer service only an email. And there is no timely response. I am calling my credit card to cancel the transaction and get a refund and am never ever ordering from them anything again. Do not buy from them.

May 20, 2024

Unprompted review

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

May 30, 2024

Hello, our Customer Experience team is working through an influx of inquiries so we’re taking a little longer to get back to everyone. Rest assured, we do respond to every email we receive. We just sent you a request through Trustpilot to gather a little more information about your experience so we can escalate this to our Customer Experience team.
